summary: Nefs Aardappelen is a potato processor in Halsteren, Noord-Brabant, that peels and cuts fresh chilled potato products, mainly fresh fries, for snack bars, large kitchens and greengrocers. It was founded in 1964 as a potato grower and trader and began peeling and cutting in 1988.
products: Fresh fries in 10, 11, 12 and 13 mm cuts
Peeled and washed bonken for cutting fries
facts: Founded in 1964 as a grower and trader of potatoes for large kitchens and cafeterias
Began peeling and cutting potato products in 1988
Products are vacuum-packed with a stated shelf life of six days
Delivers to customers several times a week with its own refrigerated transport

contact.address: Nefs Aardappelen, Koningsspil 15, 4661 TW Halsteren, Noord-Brabant, Netherlands
